_demand_record.detail: RE-ANCHOR (existing registry corridor). _demand_record.detail: SOURCED full annual line ridership for the Karaköy-Kadıköy line = 7,254,757 (2013-2014 period, ITU/Şehir Hatları Planning Unit data). This is a realized water-pool already carrying millions/yr → full pool is the base, premium capture downstream. Peak was 8,281,267 (2010-2011); the 2013-14 figure reflects the Marmaray-opening dip. CONFIDENCE MEDIUM: figure is 2013-14 (last published per-line split); treat as conservative order-of-magnitude (network has since recovered to 40M/yr for Şehir Hatları, 2023).

_fare_record.source: IMM Sea Taxi shared per-seat on 11 nm = (500+11×750)/10 = 875 TL ÷ 46.4 = $18.86 (whole-boat 8750 TL = $188.6). Scheduled premium = İDO/Şehir Hatları fast-ferry Adalar tier.

_demand_record.detail: FULL Büyükada annual visitor pool ~2,000,000 (Para Dergi: 'her yıl adayı iki milyon turist ziyaret ediyor'). Boat is the only access mode → full pool is the base, premium capture downstream. SHARED-POOL FLAG: the wider Adalar (Princes' Islands) district draws ~13.5M visitors/yr (Bianet) across all islands/feeders — this same Adalar pool also feeds the Bostancı→Büyükada corridor below, which is set NULL to avoid double-count. Confidence MEDIUM (secondary press citing island figures).

Gap: no Turk

(İzmir metro bay ferries) carried 14,621,849 passengers in 2023 (+1,256,843 vehicles, +225,960 cyclists) across 9 bay piers (Bostanlı, Karşıyaka, Mordoğan, Foça, Alsancak, Pasaport, Konak, Göztepe, Üçkuyular).
